# ESM — Protein Language Models

Curated by Skill Harbor — a practical skill for EvolutionaryScale's ESM protein language models: generative protein design with ESM3 (sequence, structure and function tracks), inverse folding, protein embeddings with ESMC for classification and similarity, chain-of-thought design refinement, batch processing via the hosted Forge/Biohub API, plus a model selection guide (esm3-open for local work, hosted medium/large for quality) and responsible-use guidance (Responsible Biodesign Framework, biosafety before wet-lab validation). The skill is part of the "Scientific Agent Skills" library with an accompanying arXiv paper and asks for citation when it contributes to a manuscript. Discovered via skills.sh, listed here with credit to its creator by @k-dense (K-Dense Inc.). Honest caveats: research-grade tooling — local use needs a CUDA GPU, Python 3.12 and large model downloads; hosted Forge/Biohub inference needs an API key and possibly a paid account — check current terms; a near-duplicate older ESM skill (v1.1) exists from another author and was deliberately not listed — this is the newer v1.2. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
